## Australia

### AI agents used to break into company websites, including Australian ecommerce sites

A researcher at NorForge watched a Chinese-speaking attacker hand almost all of a hacking spree to autonomous AI agents, which probed and broke into websites of more than 100 companies. iTnews reports ecommerce sites in Australia, Canada, the US and Japan were among those targeted.

> **Action:** Review exposed admin interfaces and web application logs for automated probing.

<sub>Sources: [iTnews](https://www.itnews.com.au/news/how-one-hacker-used-ai-agents-and-a-few-thousand-dollars-to-break-into-scores-of-sites-629764) · [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/hackers-use-autonomous-ai-agents-to.html)</sub>

## Vulnerabilities and advisories

### PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257 under active exploitation

Unit 42 says ransomware operators, including the groups behind Qilin and Inc, are attempting to exploit an authentication bypass in GlobalProtect portal and gateway components of vulnerable PAN-OS versions.

> **Action:** Patch affected firewalls and check GlobalProtect logs.

<sub>Sources: [Unit 42](https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/active-exploitation-of-pan-os-cve-2026-0257/)</sub>

### Siemens Software Center flaw exploited in ClickFix attacks

Siemens says attackers have used CVE-2026-110936, a DLL search-path weakness, in a malware campaign. Version 4.0.9.8 fixes it and installed copies update automatically on next launch.

> **Action:** Confirm installed copies have updated to version 4.0.9.8.

<sub>Sources: [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/siemens-software-center-vulnerability-exploited-in-clickfix-malware-attacks/) · [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/clickfix-attackers-exploit-siemens.html)</sub>

### Critical NGINX and Drupal fixes

F5 released out-of-band patches for NGINX, including three critical flaws (CVE-2026-15176, CVE-2026-97205, CVE-2026-93479) that can allow code execution on some non-default configurations. Drupal patched two critical remote code execution bugs (CVE-2026-108099, CVE-2026-108097) that become exploitable with common contributed modules, in at least one case without authentication.

> **Action:** Apply the F5 NGINX and Drupal core updates.

<sub>Sources: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/f5-releases-out-of-band-patches-for-critical-nginx-vulnerabilities/) · [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/drupal-warns-of-fast-exploitation-risk-for-critical-core-rce-flaw/)</sub>

## Incidents and threats

### ConnectWise switches off Cloud Backup after Microsoft 365 tenants were accessed

A stolen ConnectWise application credential let attackers sign in to customers' Microsoft 365 environments; Huntress confirmed unauthorised sign-ins in 162 tenants. ConnectWise has disabled seven application identities and says it found no evidence stored backups were accessed.

> **Action:** MSPs and their customers should review Microsoft 365 sign-ins and app consents.

<sub>Sources: [iTnews](https://www.itnews.com.au/news/stolen-connectwise-skykick-credential-exposed-microsoft-365-tenants-629721) · [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/connectwise-suspends-cloud-backup-after.html)</sub>

### Software supply chains hit three ways

Google and ManageEngine attribute the hijacking of AOMEI Backupper's update and notification systems (April to July 2026) to a group tracked as UNC7017. Five OVHcloud CLI releases on GitHub were swapped for a secret-stealing build for up to 94 minutes on 19 October. Rank Math PRO downloads and updates between 15 and 16 October carried a self-restoring WordPress backdoor.

> **Action:** Treat sites that updated Rank Math PRO on 15–16 October as compromised.

<sub>Sources: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-hijack-aomei-update-servers-to-secretly-spread-malware/) · [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/hackers-hijack-five-ovhcloud-cli.html) · [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/popular-wordpress-seo-plugin-rank-math.html)</sub>

### APT28 linked to breaches of NATO defence suppliers

Symantec attributes a campaign against two NATO member states, including a naval shipbuilder and a military aircraft engine maker, to APT28, using a backdoor and a new in-memory loader.

<sub>Sources: [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/russian-apt28-breaches-nato-naval.html) · [The Record](https://therecord.media/european-defense-contractors-fancy-bear-espionage)</sub>

### Ahold Delhaize restoring services after cyberattack

The retailer says last week's attack disrupted websites, apps and store services in Europe and the US.

<sub>Sources: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/ahold-delhaize-cyberattack-affects-services-across-us-and-europe/)</sub>

### OpenCode console breach may have exposed AI provider keys

OpenCode says an intruder reached a legacy system on 16 October; affected Console users were emailed to revoke and replace their OpenAI, Anthropic and Google keys.

<sub>Sources: [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/opencode-console-breach-may-have.html)</sub>
